text.card: A red giant 1,224 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,929 K at its surface.
